record.name: Rwanda
record.summary: No qualifying institute identified. Cabinet approved a National AI Agency on 8 June 2026 with a development, adoption, investment and governance remit.

related_bodies.name: National Artificial Intelligence Agency (approved June 2026)
related_bodies.role: It is a general AI development and governance agency; no model evaluation mandate was found in the report read.

related_bodies.name: Responsible AI Office, MINICT
related_bodies.role: It is called for in the 2023 National AI Policy to coordinate implementation; it is not an evaluation body.

check.language_note: English is an official language or an official language of national administration; it is a practical national search language for this check. Other national or official languages were not exhaustively searched. Search source_ids identify registered source URLs matched in the retrieved result set, which may include irrelevant hits. An empty list means no registered source URL was matched, not that the web response was empty. The earlier audit used independent_source_ids for substantive corroboration; governance_source_ids, where present, identifies the selected primary governance evidence.
check.independence_note: Historical audit under the superseded two-independent-sources rule: Two substantively independent evidence origins were not established. Multiple pages from one owner, mirrors, reports of the same underlying announcement and general regional coverage are not counted as independent corroboration.
check.governance_note: The ministry-authored National AI Policy recommends a Responsible AI Office within MINICT to coordinate policy implementation and stakeholders; the recommendation is not proof that the office was established. The policy was retrieved from WHO's repository, not a Rwandan government host, and no byte-for-byte comparison with a government-hosted copy was made.
